description: Angular component for dynamic form property panel, managing form controls, validation, and user interactions for property configuration.

classes.name: DynamicFormPropertyPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for dynamic form property panel, handling property editing and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, and subscribes to value changes for validation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without saving changes.

methods.name: applyPropertySettings
methods.description: Emits the current form values as a property configuration.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form control validators based on property type and other conditions.

methods.name: onSelectItemsChange
methods.description: Updates default value based on selected items and type.

methods.name: onMultipleSelectChange
methods.description: Adjusts default value and options when multiple selection is toggled.
